product_statement: Document Protocol Lab ships as an interactive casebook for bounded document-comparison judgment. It keeps claim, proof, and stop visible across six public cases.
anti_hype_statement: This is a curated six-case casebook, not a general document chatbot, broad filing catalog, or benchmark-grade product comparison.
why_this_mix_matters: NVDA, LLY, and KO teach vivid answer, honest stop, and useful restraint, while META, TSLA, and WMT keep the same claim, proof, and stop grammar under added pressure.
